message.content:
A vertical magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, yellow block letters features a centered, stylized illustration of a man. The man has short black hair, tanned skin with fine hatching for shadow, and a slight smile. He is depicted from the chest up, tearing open a grey and white striped outer garment with both hands to reveal a navy blue pinstriped suit, light blue shirt, and red tie underneath. His hands, with visible fingernails, grip the edges of the striped fabric.

The background consists of jagged orange and blue horizontal shapes. Large white text on the right reads "SUPER NAPI," while text on the left says "SUPER NAZAR" and "Bahkan dari dalam penjara ia masih mengendalikan 'bisnis'-nya." The top of the cover reads "CALO DAN KISRUH TKI JEDDAH" in yellow. Smaller text indicates "EDISI 17-23 JUNI 2013." A barcode and "RP 33.000" are in the bottom right corner. The illustration uses a comic book aesthetic with thick black outlines and vibrant colors.
